title: Checkout Redemption Limits for Gift Cards & Store Credit
content:
At checkout, each Gift Cards & Store Credit type is limited in how many instruments of that type can pay one order, in the merchandise subtotal an order must reach before the type can be applied, and in what charges it may pay. No type ever pays a pre-order deposit, and no balance may go below zero.

| Instrument type | Most instruments of this type on one order | Merchandise subtotal after discounts required before it applies (USD) | Pays shipping fees and surcharges | Pays a pre-order deposit | Balance may go below zero |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Marlowe Rewards Note | 10 | 0.00 (none) | No | No | No |
| Bonus Gift Card | 1 | 50.00 | No | No | No |
| Goodwill Credit | 2 | 0.00 (none) | Yes | No | No |
| Return Store Credit | 5 | 0.00 (none) | Yes | No | No |
| Marlowe & Finch Gift Card | 5 | 0.00 (none) | Yes | No | No |
| Marlowe & Finch e-Gift Card | 5 | 0.00 (none) | Yes | No | No |

Pre-order deposits are taken by card under the Pre-Orders & Back-Orders terms, so no stored-value instrument can pay one; the balance due at shipment is paid on the fulfilment order like any other order.

## Illustrations (hypothetical orders)

| Hypothetical order | Result under the schedule |
|---|---|
| Merchandise subtotal after discounts of 49.99, Bonus Gift Card offered | The Bonus Gift Card does not apply: the subtotal has not reached 50.00 |
| Merchandise subtotal after discounts of 50.00, Bonus Gift Card offered | The Bonus Gift Card applies: the subtotal reaches 50.00 |
| Three Goodwill Credits offered on one order | At most two of them pay the order |
| Order with a shipping fee, paid with a Marlowe Rewards Note | The note pays merchandise only; it does not pay the shipping fee |
